name: Belebele
description: A massively multilingual reading comprehension benchmark with fully parallel examples across 122 language variants, based on FLORES-200 passages. Each question asks models to select the correct answer from 4 options about a short passage. Enables direct cross-lingual comparison of reading comprehension with zero translation variance between languages.
typical_sota_score: ~85–95% for high-resource languages; ~55–75% for low-resource languages (frontier models 2025)
reputation: Most language-diverse NLU benchmark available; published at ACL 2024 by Meta AI; covers 122 languages including many low-resource; enables true cross-lingual comparison; used in Artificial Analysis Multilingual Index
notes: 1,000 questions × 122 language variants = 122,000 total. Passages sourced from FLORES-200, ensuring high translation quality. Allows direct comparison without translation artifacts since all questions are independently verified. Published at ACL 2024. One of the most comprehensive multilingual benchmarks available.
